hero.headline: Industrial Commissioning,
hero.subheadline: Digitize ITRs, Punch Lists, Certificates, Preservation and KPIs in a single cloud-native platform — built for Oil & Gas, LNG, renewables, mining and heavy industry projects.

problem.title: Commissioning is still managed with tools that weren't designed for the field.
problem.card1Title: Scattered ITRs with no reliable document control
problem.card1Desc: Checklists across folders, binders, WhatsApp photos and emails. No traceability, no single source, no audit trail.
problem.card2Title: Punch Lists without a single source of truth
problem.card2Desc: Multiple Excel files, outdated data and no unified tracking. Real project progress is unknown until it's too late.
problem.card3Title: Certificates issued without blocking critical deficiencies
problem.card3Desc: No automatic blocking logic. Cat A punches reaching operations — causing costly rework and startup delays.
problem.label: Features

import.title: Import systemization from Excel
import.help: "Systems" sheet: SYSTEM, NAME, TYPE (process / utility / safety), PRIORITY (P1–P5) and limits (INLET, OUTLET, ELECTRICAL, INSTRUMENTATION, UTILITIES, NOTES). "Dependencies" sheet: SYSTEM, DEPENDS ON, DEPENDENCY TYPE and, optionally, REQUIRED GATE and BLOCKED GATE (defaults apply when empty). Systems must already exist: the hierarchy importer creates them. Empty cells do not erase existing data.

ai.title: AI suggestions for systemization
ai.help: The AI proposes each system's type, priority and name, plus missing dependencies, from areas, subsystems and tags. Nothing is saved until you apply. Systems your team already defined come unchecked; dependencies are created with the default gates for their type and can be adjusted on the system page.

ai.gatesNote: Dependencies use the default gates: utility = provider in service before commissioning; process = upstream start-up before start-up.

ai.done: Done: {systems} systems updated and {dependencies} dependencies created.

Registers.title: Controlled registers
Registers.subtitle: Temporary plant state: temporary installations, blinds, reinstatement, bypasses, energization and test packs. Each open register can block a gate.

kindHelp.temporary: Temporary hoses, spools, strainers, power or software changes (guide 6.9, 16.35).
kindHelp.blind: Blinds and spades installed for testing or isolation, each with its physical tag (16.40).
kindHelp.reinstatement: Temporary condition → final condition, verified by another person (10.15.1).
kindHelp.bypass: Inhibited or forced protections: reason, mitigation and restoration (16.34).
kindHelp.energization: Energized equipment: boundary, authority and certificate (12.8–12.9).
kindHelp.test_pack: Pressure test of a group of lines, with gauges, result and witness (8.15, 10.29).

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Blind at P-101A suction for hydrotest
form.systemHelp: If no system is chosen, the register affects the systems of its tags.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
detail.closed: Closed register: it can no longer be edited.
detail.otherPerson: This step must be done by someone other than {who}.
detail.blocks: While open it blocks gate {gate} of its system.
detail.noBlock: This type does not block any gate.
detail.rejected: The test was rejected: repeat the test (new test pack) before reinstating or verifying.
detail.openBlinds: Note: blinds {list} are still installed. You can verify the pack; each blind keeps blocking its gate until removed and verified.
detail.label: Print QR label
detail.linkedBlindsHelp: Blinds installed for this test. Afterwards they are removed and verified in their own register.

admin.title: Controlled registers
admin.subtitle: Enable the types your organization uses and choose which gate each one blocks while it has open registers in a system.

testPacks.title: Test packs
testPacks.subtitle: Pressure test progress by pack, line and system. A line is tested once a pack that contains it is verified.
testPacks.emptyPacks: No test packs yet. Create them one by one or import the line list.

importer.title: Import test packs and line list
importer.help: "Packs" sheet: pack number (the client's, e.g. TP-101, or CommUp's TPK), title, system, test type, medium, pressures and hold time. "Lines" sheet: line (existing tag) and pack. New packs are created and open ones are completed; lines are added, never removed. Lines that do not exist as tags are reported.
importer.nothingFound: No packs or lines sheet found (TEST PACK and LINE columns).
importer.readError: The file could not be read.
importer.preview: {packs} packs and {lines} lines ready to import.
importer.done: Done: {created} packs created, {updated} updated, {lines} lines linked.

labels.scan: Scan with CommUp to see the current status of the register.

PunchVerification.resolveLabel: What was done to resolve it?
PunchVerification.resolvePlaceholder: E.g. flange gasket replaced and bolts re-torqued to spec
PunchVerification.resolveHint: Someone else then verifies it in the field.
PunchVerification.confirmNoPhotos: This punch has no photos. Mark it resolved without photo evidence?
PunchVerification.waitingOther: Waiting for field verification by someone else.
PunchVerification.verifyHint: Verify in the field before closing. Rejecting sends the punch back to "in progress".

PunchGuide.mismatch: You chose Cat {chosen}, but a {impact} impact suggests Cat {suggested}.
PunchGuide.functionNotSize: Category is decided by functional impact, not size.
PunchGuide.reviewByOther: The category is reviewed by a supervisor other than the originator.
PunchGuide.procedureHint: Punch raising procedure to hand over to the client
PunchGuide.pssrHelp: Every open punch needs a disposition; those marked «close before start-up» must be closed before submitting and approving the PSSR.
PunchGuide.pssrNone: The system has no open punches.
PunchGuide.pssrOk: All {n} open punches have a disposition and none blocks start-up.
PunchGuide.pssrBlocked: Blocks the PSSR: {missing} without disposition and {mustClose} to close before start-up.

TestEquipment.title: Test equipment
TestEquipment.subtitle: Organisation inventory with calibration status. An ITR cannot be signed if the equipment used was out of calibration on the test date.
TestEquipment.deleteConfirm: Delete equipment {code}? Only possible if it was never used in an ITR.
TestEquipment.blockMissing: Record the test equipment used: this ITR cannot be signed without it.
TestEquipment.blockExpired: Out of calibration on the date of use: {codes}. Replace it to be able to sign.
TestEquipment.pickExpired: This equipment is expired today: it can be recorded, but the ITR will not be signable.
TestEquipment.noInventory: No more active equipment in the inventory.

Daily.title: Daily management
Daily.subtitle: Project actions, constraints, technical queries (TQ) and decisions. No hidden constraints: an open constraint puts its gate under conditions and, at level 4, blocks it.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.help: Photos, documents or minutes that back up the record. Evidence cannot be deleted.
evidence.required: Required to mark the action as done (method other than “review”). Evidence cannot be deleted.

field.title: Title
field.impactHint: What gets delayed or what risk it creates
field.subject: Subject
field.question: Question
field.supersedeReason: Why the previous decision is superseded

help.action: An action has an owner, a date and a verification method. Whoever does it closes it; someone else verifies it.
help.constraint: Something blocking a system: with owner, need date, impact and recovery plan.
help.tq: Technical query to engineering, a vendor or the client. Created as a draft and issued when ready.
help.decision: Stays in the project log. It is not edited: if it changes, it is superseded by a new one.
help.constraintGate: If you pick a gate, the open constraint puts it “ready with conditions”; at level 4 it blocks it.
help.decisionImmutable: Decisions are never edited or deleted: they are superseded and the previous one stays in the log.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

action.needsEvidence: Attach the evidence before marking it done.
action.otherPerson: You closed it: someone else must verify it.
action.closePlaceholder: How it was closed (required to mark done)

constraint.blocksGate: Open at level 4: blocks gate {gate} for this system.
constraint.conditionsGate: While open, gate {gate} for this system is “ready with conditions”.
constraint.openActions: Unverified actions: {list}. Verify them to close.
constraint.escalationHelp: 1 team · 2 commissioning manager · 3 project manager · 4 client/sponsor. Every change keeps its reason.

tq.reissued: Reissued: the previous answer was not enough.
tq.designChangeQ: The answer implies a design change
tq.reissuePlaceholder: Why the answer is not enough (to reissue)
tq.lockedQuestion: Issued: subject and question can no longer change.

lookahead.subtitle: What is due in the next 7, 30 or 90 days: gates by forecast or commitment, actions, constraints, TQs and work plans. Overdue items keep showing until closed.
lookahead.saved: {n, plural, one {# date saved} other {# dates saved}}.
lookahead.help: Up to {end}. Risk = the gate is due in the window and is not ready. Gap = forecast − commitment (positive: late against commitment).
lookahead.editHelp: F = forecast (best estimate, adjust freely). C = commitment (firm date; changing it needs a reason and is logged).
lookahead.editHelpNoCommit: F = forecast. Only leaders or above set commitments.
lookahead.saveChanges: Save {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}

reports.subtitle: Daily project report: the day’s data comes from the database, AI drafts the text and the issuer reviews it. Once issued it is immutable (hash); corrections are issued as a revision.

handovers.subtitle: Shift handover: what stays in the field (bypasses, blinds, temporaries, energised items, Cat A punches, constraints) plus pending items and safety notes. Signed by whoever hands over and whoever receives.

report.createHelp: If a draft for that date exists, it opens and its data is refreshed. If it was issued, open it and create a revision.
report.aiOff: AI is not configured in this environment: fill in the sections manually.
report.issueRole: Only leaders or above issue the report.

placeholder.summary: 3–5 sentences: progress, the day’s highlights and the main risk.
placeholder.key_events: - Relevant ITRs, gates or punches of the day
placeholder.issues: - Failures, regressions, Cat A punches, overdue actions
placeholder.constraints: - L≥3 or overdue constraints and their recovery

report.dataNote: PDF figures come from this data, not from the text. “Refresh data” retakes the snapshot (draft only).
report.aiReplaceConfirm: The report already has text. Replace it with the AI draft? (Cancel = AI only fills empty sections)
report.issueConfirm: Once issued the report becomes immutable. Issue now?

handover.openHelp: What is in the field today is preloaded; the snapshot is retaken when handing over.
handover.safetyHint: Isolations, active bypasses, hot work, restricted areas…
handover.pending: Pending items for the incoming shift
handover.pendingHint: - What to finish, what to watch, whom to call
handover.handOverConfirm: Handing over takes the final field snapshot and locks editing. Hand over?
handover.onlyOpener: Only {who} (who opened it) can edit and hand it over.
handover.commentHint: Comment (optional): what you checked on receiving
handover.waiting: Waiting for someone else to receive it.
handover.registers: Registers in the field (bypasses, blinds, temporaries, energised)

Startup.title: Start-up
Startup.subtitle: Procedures with hold points and stop criteria, and line-up sheets with independent verification. A gate that requires a line-up cannot be approved without a verified, current sheet for the system.
Startup.generate: Generate rows from the system valves (ESD, block and relief valves marked critical)

hint.purpose: What this procedure is meant to achieve.
hint.scope: System, equipment included and battery limits.
hint.references: P&IDs, datasheets, vendor manuals, related procedures.
hint.responsibilities: Who executes, who supervises, who releases each hold point.
hint.safety: PTW, PPE, hazards and controls, communications.
hint.prerequisites: Approved gates, ITRs, closed F3 registers, utilities available.
hint.isolations: Isolations, blinds and bypasses required and their state.
hint.initial_lineup: Reference to the line-up sheet (LU-…) or key positions.
hint.stop_criteria: Conditions that force a stop and what to do.
hint.acceptance: Values and conditions that close the procedure.
hint.reinstatement: State the system must be left in at the end.
hint.records: Forms, ITRs and evidence to attach.

editor.author: Prepared by {who}
editor.approveConfirm: Approving makes this revision current and immutable. Approve?
editor.walkdownPrompt: Describe the walkdown (with whom, what was checked):
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
editor.otherApproves: Approval must come from someone other than the author or submitter.
editor.otherVerifies: Field verification must be done by someone other than the approver.
editor.needsApproval: The procedure needs an approved revision before it can be run.

run.resumePrompt: Why is it safe to resume?
run.holdOther: You executed it: someone else must release it.
run.isHold: Hold point: once marked, the run waits for {who} to release it.

lineup.staleHelp: An F3 register on the system (blind, bypass, temporary…) changed state after this sheet was verified: the gate treats it as expired. Issue and execute a new sheet.
lineup.registers: F3 registers in the field on this system ({n})
lineup.draftHelp: Set the required position of each valve and flag the critical ones (they need independent verification). You can add tags or manual rows.
lineup.label: Untagged valve (description)
lineup.needRequired: Every row needs its required position before issuing.
lineup.progressHelp: {pending} pending, {misaligned} misaligned and {toVerify} critical to verify.

offline.offline: Offline: what you record is saved on this device and syncs when the network is back.
offline.pending: {n, plural, =1 {# record} other {# records}} pending sync
offline.trayHelp: The server did not accept these records. Nothing is discarded unless you decide: retry (e.g. after the run is resumed) or discard it (it stays in the conflict log).
offline.held: Waiting: it is sent once you resolve the previous record (steps go in order).
offline.discardConfirm: Discard this record? It stays in the conflict log.
offline.conflictHelp: Someone else changed or verified this row after your capture. "Apply mine" records your position and clears their verification.
offline.syncFirst: Sync the pending records before this action.
offline.locked: There are unsynced records: resolve them to continue the run.
offline.holdPending: Release will be requested on sync: someone else does it online.

events.subtitle: Start-up log: per-system milestones (once each, witnessed) and free events. Recording freezes the IIoT signal readings at that time; first start-up and first HC require the start-up gate and PSSR approved.
events.witnessBy: This milestone is witnessed by {who} (someone else).
events.already: This milestone is already recorded for the system; void the previous one to correct it.
events.needGate: gate {gate} must be approved with all signatures (now: {status}).
events.prereqOk: Start-up prerequisites met: {gate} approved and {pssr} approved.
events.pickSystem: Choose a system to see its signals.
events.snapshotHelp: The sample closest to the event time is stored (±5 min, good quality preferred). With no data it stays “no data” for manual entry.
events.witnessOther: You recorded it: someone else must witness it.

ops.subtitle: Ownership stage of each system (Commissioning → Shadowing → Joint operation → Operations), signed transfers, operations staff competency and critical spares.
ops.justifyPlaceholder: Justify the exception (10 characters or more)

check.staff_level_1: Staff at level ≥ 1 on every shift
check.staff_level_2: Staff at level ≥ 2 on every shift
check.staff_level_3: Staff at level ≥ 3 on every shift

detail.noStaff: No staff assessed on this system
detail.noFirstStartup: Milestone not recorded or not witnessed

ops.noPeople: Register the operations staff first (Personnel tab).
ops.handoverFailed: The transfer was completed but the handover package was not generated: {error}. Use “Generate package” to retry.
ops.handoverMissing: The system handover package has not been generated yet.

perf.subtitle: Performance test (ch. 18): approved definition with measurable criteria, attempt with stabilization and formal period, disturbances and frozen data.
perf.primaryHint: The primary system is the one shown in Control Tower and feeding the gate. The boundary may include more systems.
perf.approveOther: Someone other than the author approves.
perf.deleteConfirm: Delete this test? Allowed only because it was never approved.
perf.needApproved: The definition must be approved to open an attempt.
perf.variablesHint: Each variable is an IIoT signal, a manual reading or derived from two variables. Criteria use the key (P, F1, KW…).
perf.manualHint: Entered in the console during the test
perf.pairsHint: Pairs of variables that must agree (e.g. inlet and outlet FT) within a maximum difference.

sectionHint.purpose: What is demonstrated (capacity, efficiency, product quality…)
sectionHint.boundary: From where to where it is measured
sectionHint.conditions: Required load, feed and ambient conditions
sectionHint.method: How it is run and measured
sectionHint.uncertainty: Measurement uncertainty and how it applies
sectionHint.responsibilities: Who leads, operates, records and accepts

perf.outdatedRun: The definition of this attempt was superseded by a new revision.
perf.closeConfirm: Close the formal period? The attempt's data will be frozen.
perf.frozenRows: IIoT data frozen: {n, plural, one {# one-minute row} other {# one-minute rows}}.
perf.frozenAt: {n, plural, one {# row frozen} other {# rows frozen}} (IIoT + manual) · {when}
perf.disturbancesHint: Record trips, load changes or instrument faults. A leader may exclude the window from the calculation with a reason.

dist.excludePrompt: Reason to exclude from the calculation

reason.unit: signal unit differs from the definition

eval.title: Evaluation
eval.window: Formal period: {valid} valid min of {total} ({excluded} excluded by disturbances). Minimum coverage {cov} %.
eval.confirm: Record the result? The evaluation is frozen and the attempt can no longer be changed.
eval.actionHint: An action will be created in Daily management.
eval.leadOnly: A leader or above records the result.
